reasoning_content:
Let me check the fs-watcher logs and see whether the transcription proceeds this time. The earlier permission error was because the fs-watcher was dropping to uid 1000 (APP_UID=1000), but the files were root-owned. I chown'd the watch directory to 1000. But the .local data directory and /mnt are... wait, /mnt is the watch directory (bind-mounted). Let me check.

Actually the fs-watcher runs as uid 1000 (APP_UID=1000), and it needs to write "Transkript_in_Arbeit.log" to /mnt (the watch directory). I chown'd watch to 1000. So now it should work.

Let me monitor.

action.command: cd /workspace/deployments/example-opencode && for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do sleep 30; echo "=== iter $i ==="; docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml logs --tail 4 fs-watcher 2>&1 | tr '\r' '\n' | grep -vE "DEBUG" | tail -4; echo "--- watch dir:"; ls -la watch/ | grep -vE "keep"; echo "--- asr recent (non-debug):"; docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml logs --tail 30 asr-service 2>&1 | tr '\r' '\n' | grep -vE "DEBUG|httpcore|GPUWatchdog|monitor" | tail -10; if ls watch/ | grep -qiE "\.txt$|Transkript|\.vtt$|\.srt$"; then echo "TRANSCRIPT FOUND"; break; fi; done
